states.name: S_INITIALIZING
states.description: Power-up monitoring inhibition active. Weld_Soft_Start_Active is TRUE. Operator_Alert is forced FALSE. Gap debounce timing is inhibited/reset.

states.name: S_MONITORING
states.description: Post-startup normal monitoring. Gap_Exceeded may qualify after continuous DebounceTime when E-stop is inactive. Weld_Soft_Start_Active is FALSE.

transitions.guard: StartupTimer.Q == TRUE, i.e. startupActive == FALSE. State is supervisory; functional gating uses post-stage-3 startupActive derived from StartupTimer.Q.
StartupTimer.Q == TRUE; no return to initialization without power cycle/fresh FB instance.

Weld_E_Stop_NC == FALSE: E-stop priority override. Operator_Alert := FALSE; GapDebounceTimer reset. StartupTimer continues; Weld_Soft_Start_Active remains startupActive, so it can still be TRUE during E-stop if within the 5 s startup interval.
Gap_Exceeded == FALSE: Operator_Alert := FALSE and GapDebounceTimer reset.
startupActive == FALSE AND Weld_E_Stop_NC == TRUE AND Gap_Exceeded == TRUE AND GapDebounceTimer.Q == TRUE: Operator_Alert := TRUE.

timer_plan.name: StartupTimer
timer_plan.IN: TRUE after first FB invocation; remains TRUE through E-stop, gap changes, and state changes.
timer_plan.reset_conditions: Fresh FB instance/power-up only. Not reset by Weld_E_Stop_NC, Gap_Exceeded, or state transition.
timer_plan.use: StartupTimer.Q == TRUE means the 5 s initialization inhibition has completed. startupActive := NOT StartupTimer.Q. Weld_Soft_Start_Active := startupActive.

timer_plan.name: GapDebounceTimer
timer_plan.PT: DebounceTime, sampled each scan; assumed strictly positive.
timer_plan.IN: NOT startupActive AND Weld_E_Stop_NC AND Gap_Exceeded, evaluated after the unconditional StartupTimer call in stage 3.
timer_plan.reset_conditions: IN == FALSE: resets ET to zero and Q to FALSE. This occurs during startup, on E-stop active, or when Gap_Exceeded is FALSE. Also reset on fresh FB/power-up.
timer_plan.use: GapDebounceTimer.Q is TRUE only after Gap_Exceeded has remained TRUE continuously for DebounceTime while post-startup and E-stop inactive. At the exact scan startup clears, the first eligible gap invocation has ET = 0 and no debounce time is credited from the inhibition period.

priorities: 1. E-stop highest priority: Weld_E_Stop_NC == FALSE forces Operator_Alert := FALSE immediately and resets GapDebounceTimer. E-stop does not restart or reset StartupTimer, and does not change Weld_Soft_Start_Active except as determined by the continuing startup timer.
2. Power-up initialization priority: while startupActive == TRUE, Operator_Alert is forced FALSE, Weld_Soft_Start_Active is TRUE, and GapDebounceTimer is inhibited/reset.
3. Raw gap FALSE reset: Gap_Exceeded == FALSE forces Operator_Alert := FALSE and resets GapDebounceTimer immediately.
4. Normal qualified-gap alarm: Operator_Alert may be TRUE only when startupActive == FALSE, Weld_E_Stop_NC == TRUE, Gap_Exceeded == TRUE, and GapDebounceTimer.Q == TRUE.
5. Deterministic output stage: outputs are assigned once in stage 4 after safety, state, and timer execution.
scan_execution_order: Stage 1 - Edge sampling: sample Gap_Exceeded, Weld_E_Stop_NC, and DebounceTime once per scan. Latch firstScan if needed for FB initialization; no hidden input-stability assumptions are used.

Stage 2 - Safety/reset priority and state transitions: evaluate E-stop first, then startup inhibition, then raw Gap_Exceeded FALSE reset. Set supervisory state transition requests using prior retained timer/state information; final functional startupActive is recomputed after the unconditional StartupTimer call.

Stage 3 - Unconditional top-level timer FB calls outside CASE/IF: call StartupTimer(IN := TRUE, PT := T#5s); update startupActive := NOT StartupTimer.Q; set GapDebounceTimer.PT := DebounceTime; call GapDebounceTimer(IN := NOT startupActive AND Weld_E_Stop_NC AND Gap_Exceeded, PT := DebounceTime).

Stage 4 - Unified output assignments: Operator_Alert := (NOT startupActive) AND Weld_E_Stop_NC AND Gap_Exceeded AND GapDebounceTimer.Q; Weld_Soft_Start_Active := startupActive. No other output assignments occur.
